summary: Per-species meristic ranges are public for fishes (FishBase pages show min-max vertebrae, fin-ray counts), but no open dataset of individual-level or variance-bearing counts for vertebrae or stamens was found; MorphoSource and MorphoBank were not reachable by script and the VertNet API failed TLS.
next_step: Compile per-species counts with sample sizes from taxonomic revisions (fishes first, using FishBase ranges plus original tables) and pre-register the variance-vs-mean regression on that table.
obstacles_confirmed: Repositories emphasize species representatives rather than within-species samples.
Museum counts and trait databases use inconsistent sample sizes.
